decision.reason: The only evidence [ev-4b121944161e] is a one-line bug-fix note: Karpenter now makes sure EbsOptimizedInfo exists when it selects instances by EBS maximum bandwidth. The note does not say what happened before the fix (a crash, a failure or a wrong instance choice), what changes for an operator after it, or how an environment ends up selecting by EBS bandwidth. The proposed statement says environments "will no longer encounter failures", but the evidence never mentions failures, and the medium severity is also unsupported. Deciding the consequence (behavior-change vs none) needs the content of PR #6663 or an issue describing the symptom.
